description: Boundary coverage for identity-only (no-cipher) session encoding: when the address is an email it is persisted and its local part is exposed as the derived user; when no address is present the bare user is persisted (and if that bare user itself contains an '@' it is re-interpreted as an address on decode); when neither address nor user is present the identity is empty; an address without an '@' persists as-is and exposes no derived user.
